scope: Prospective execution clarification for the next independent candidate, before any new candidate predictions. Existing candidate rejections and historical protocols are not rewritten.
excluded_lineage: All 422 KIOS real frames, both KIOS capture sessions, the protected 86-frame subset, and all derived/cropped/stressed/transcoded versions are not independent evaluation data.

screening.threshold_clarification: The archived JSON requires Hamming separation >= 10. The generic screening CLI defaults to rejection at <= 8. For this locked protocol always explicitly pass --near-distance 9; the execution verifier rejects the weaker default.
screening.exact_overlap: zero byte, decoded-pixel, and normalized-source-name overlap
screening.partitioning: Disjoint whole capture sessions and source videos for development versus sealed test; never random-split related frames.
screening.negative_frame_inventory: Verified empty-target frames from the candidate capture campaign required. Document partition-specific counts before outcome analysis.

required_documented_reviews_before_admis: independent capture campaign, source camera/video/session provenance and non-derivative lineage
target ontology and annotation-box extent compatibility, blinded to detector output
annotation quality and verified negative-frame inventory
license and permission for research reanalysis; never assume source imagery inherits this repository's license
zero-overlap screening, every flagged near-match adjudication, and independent dev/test session assignments
committed candidate input lock binding every file hash, dataset revision, capture record and reviewer decision
execution_order: authenticate complete official KIOS reference archive and image inventory
source and annotate independent candidate without detector-outcome inspection
screen with explicit distance 9 and complete the documented human reviews
commit admission/input lock; a screening pass alone is not admission
evaluate development only; select at most one rule with the existing prespecified 0.05..0.95 grid, accepted-error bound 5%, and higher-threshold tie break
commit the development-rule lock and sealed-test manifest
open independent test once, with no test tuning or frame removal; report session-level counts and descriptive-only results with fewer than five independent sessions
model_policy: Original checksum-authenticated Phase 22 baseline and original Phase 23 checkpoint only, under the frozen settings/runtime. No substitute or retraining is Phase 23.
score_policy: Maximum post-NMS mapped-target confidence, zero when absent; ground truth enters evaluation only. The score is not a landing-safety probability.
